description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'LikelihoodApiResource' for handling likelihood-related operations in the Fineract project. It includes endpoints for retrieving all likelihood data, retrieving specific likelihood data by ID, and updating likelihood data, with security and serialization components.

classes.name: LikelihoodApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for managing likelihood data, including retrieval and update operations, secured by user permissions.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all likelihood data for a given 'ppiName'.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve specific likelihood data by 'likelihoodId' and 'ppiName'.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update likelihood data identified by 'likelihoodId' and 'ppiName'.
